BLOCK-DIAGONAL CQR (manager's structural lever). Yp(n x kp, +1 eigenspace) and Ym(n x n-kp, -1 eigenspace) are mutually orthogonal (double FP64 projection -> ~1e-11 cross-block leakage), so the joint CQR on the n x n concat wastes ~3/4 of its flops on ~1e-11 off-block Gram entries. Replaced with two independent per-block CQRs -> CQR cost n^3 -> kp^3+(n-kp)^3. Measured (real shape-9): joint CQR 20.7ms -> block 15.9ms (-4.9ms, -24%). End-to-end shape9 clustered 54099 -> 49091/49117us (-5ms, -9.3%, two quiet benches); geomean 39849 -> 39551.1/39567.5. Per-block Gram conditioning ~1.26e6 (+block) / ~4.09e5 (-block) -- single eigenspace, so FP64 still required (FP32 Cholesky loses pos-def) but MORE robust than the joint path: nbad=0 across 6 clustered reseeds vs the joint CQR itself tripping 1/6 (seed 123). Cross-block orthogonality guaranteed ~1e-11 << 6.10e-3 orth gate. 39/39 PASS. New run best ~39551.

BLOCK-DIAGONAL Newton-Schulz: finish orthonormalization on each eigenspace block (kp-col +1, (n-kp)-col -1) SEPARATELY instead of the joint n x n Q. The two blocks are mutually orthogonal ~1e-11 (projector), so the joint NS Gram Q^TQ has ~0 off-block entries -- computing them is wasted. Block NS costs kp^3+(n-kp)^3 vs joint n^3. Measured (real shape-9): joint NS ~7.8ms -> block NS ~5.3ms (concat incl). Stacks with the block-CQR (t7). RESULT: shape9 clustered 49091->46566/46930/46566us (-2.5ms); geomean 39551->39322.8/39408.2/39393.1 (3 benches). ROBUSTNESS: per-block NS gives orth margin 0.037*gate (BETTER than joint NS 0.12 and MUCH better than skip-NS's 0.31); nbad=0 across 6 clustered reseeds; 2/3 benches perfectly clean (shape9 std <32us, best=worst), 1 run had a single rare fallback spike (worst 75ms of 200 runs, mean unaffected) -- far safer than skip-NS (t9, 3/12 draws fell back). This is the robust best (block-CQR + block-NS), preferred over both t7 (39551, more NS cost) and t9 (39233 mean but fragile). 39/39 PASS.
